camel_example: aliyun quotas ListProductQuotas --region cn-hangzhou --QuotaActionCode 'q_security-groups' --Dimensions.1.Value 'cn-hangzhou' --Dimensions.1.Key regionId --NextToken AAAAAd0000 --ProductCode ecs --KeyWord security --MaxResults 30 --QuotaCategory FlowControl --SortOrder Ascending --GroupCode entconsole_w1j3ms0000 --SortField TIME
description_en: Queries a list of quotas for a specified cloud product
description_zh: 查询目标云产品的配额列表
kebab_example: aliyun quotas list-product-quotas --next-token AAAAAd0000 --max-results 30 --product-code ecs --quota-action-code q_security-groups --key-word security --sort-field TIME --sort-order Ascending --dimensions Value=cn-hangzhou Key=regionId --quota-category FlowControl --group-code entconsole_w1j3ms0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListProductQuotas

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to initiate the next query.

- Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no subsequent query is needed.

- If a subsequent query is needed, set the value to the NextToken value that is returned from the last API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。

- 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
- 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次 API 调用返回的 NextToken 值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of records to return for the query.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
本次查询的最大记录条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：30
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The abbreviation of the cloud product.

> For more information about how to obtain the abbreviation of a cloud product, see the `ProductCode` parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的缩写名称。

> 关于如何获取云产品的缩写名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html中的`ProductCode`
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The keyword to use for searching quotas.

> This parameter is applicable only to instance type quotas of Elastic Compute Service (ECS). The search is performed on `QuotaName` and `QuotaActionCode`
parameters.help_zh:
配额的搜索关键字。
> 该参数仅针对云服务器ECS规格配额（ecs-spec），搜索范围：`QuotaName`，`QuotaActionCode`
parameters.name: key_word

parameters.help_en:
The field to use for sorting the quotas.

> This parameter is applicable only to instance type quotas of ECS. If you do not set this parameter, the query results are not sorted
parameters.help_zh:
配额支持的排序方式。

> 该参数仅针对云服务器ECS规格配额（ecs-spec），如果不设置，则为空
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en:
The order to sort the results.

> This parameter is applicable only to instance type quotas of ECS. If you do not set this parameter, the query results are not sorted
parameters.help_zh:
配额支持的排序方式。

> 该参数仅针对云服务器ECS规格配额（ecs-spec），如果不设置，则为空
parameters.name: sort_order

element_fields.help_en:
The key of the quota dimension.

> The value of N depends on the number of dimensions that are supported by the cloud product
element_fields.help_zh:
配额维度的Key。

> N的取值范围取决于对应云产品支持的维度个数
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The value of the quota dimension.

> The value of N depends on the number of dimensions that are supported by the cloud product
element_fields.help_zh:
配额维度的Value。

> N的取值范围取决于对应云产品支持的维度个数
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The quota category.

Default value: CommonQuota
parameters.name: quota_category

parameters.help_en: The code of the dimension group
parameters.name: group_code
